rodris interview to dazn ahead of his first el clásico its always a pleasure to return to spanish football and experience el clásico given its global significance ive been fortunate to return to spain as some players who spend their careers in england may not receive the same recognition well continue on our path the psg defeat was a setback but we have the right mentality and the desire to keep working and doing things properly real madrid play differently from us but the competitive spirit is always there especially in a game like el clásico we expect them to give everything ive been told real madrid have won only one of their last six or seven clásicos so theyll be eager to bounce back fcblive

pedris words to dsports on lionel messi argentina and el clásico argentina has a special place in my heart because of leo messi ive supported him since i was a child and whenever spain were eliminated from tournaments i would always support argentina because of the love ive had for leo for years in argentina i support newells old boys because of messi my hair dye was the result of a promise i made before winning the world cup it has grown a little now but when the time comes to get rid of it i will for me messi is the greatest player in history i know some people have different opinions but based on what ive seen myself no one comes close to him i was lucky enough to play alongside him for a whole year but that year felt far too short i wish i could have spent many more years with him clásico for me its like any other match even though i fully understand how important it is for us i stick to my usual routine and dont do anything special just because were facing real madrid fcblive

joan garcías words to beteve ahead of el clásico we wanted to win in paris but we knew it would be a difficult match playing every three or four days means you have to shift your focus quickly we competed well against a fantastic team that reached the champions league final in the last two seasons there were positives but also things we need to analyse and improve overall i think the match helped us more than it hurt us ahead of el clásico it would be a mistake to think that winning el clásico could guarantee us the league title titles arent decided in october we respect our opponents but were very excited to put in a great performance and win el clásico at home is courtois the best gk in the world obviously courtois has proven over many years that hes one of the best goalkeepers in the world can barcelona win every trophy yes absolutely we have a fantastic squad and have shown that we can compete with everyone and for every title the champions league should be one of our objectives but the same applies to la liga and the copa del rey we have a squad capable of competing in all three competitions so we must believe we can win everything and work hard to achieve it how do you describe szczęsny szczęsny is a special character he has moments when he jokes and makes everyone laugh but he also knows when to be serious when its time to work hard in training he does so its no coincidence that hes spent so many years at the highest level your move from espanyol to barça how did you make the decision it was a very important decision in my career i spoke extensively with the people closest to me and we concluded that it was the best option for me i made the decision without any doubts i havent lost any friendships because of the move you have to separate personal relationships from professional life i havent had any problems in that regard and im very happy about it fans chanting joan garcía from la masia at spotify camp noy this chant is funny laughs my teammates too joke with me about it in the dressing room i take it in good spirits and with a sense of humour fcblive
